stations.title: Theo
stations.say: Can the morning check be quicker?

stations.title: Stock room
stations.text: Could count every shelf at the same time.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Asks one thing at a time

captions: Failures are handled. Now Theo wants his morning check of shelves and parcels faster.
Today it asks one shelf, waits, asks the next, and one lost parcel empties the whole list.
You ask one after another on purpose, then all together, and keep the rest when one fails.
Every shelf and parcel is asked at once, and the answers come back in the order asked.
The shop waits on the world in good order now: in turn, together, and through failures.
